register.labelZh: HEAD 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: head for 和 head towards 可以用來描述人、車輛或一群人正在前往哪個方向。；head off 可以自然地表示離開某處並開始一段行程。；head something off 可以表示在問題、爭執、投訴或延誤真正發生前及早採取行動。；head off 表示出發;head something off 則表示阻止某事。懂得分辨兩者,可以更準確理解日常英語。
register.summaryEn: head for and head towards are useful when describing the direction in which a person, vehicle or group is moving. head off is a natural way to describe leaving a place and starting a journey or activity. head something off is useful when somebody acts early to prevent a problem, argument, complaint or delay. head off means to leave, while head something off means to prevent or stop something. Knowing the difference helps you understand real conversations more accurately.
